integrity: Self-contained case-by-case proof with an exact-rational finite-domain reproducibility check; no inference of universal results from finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Finite degree-two cycle; K=2, uniform alpha/2 competitive interactions and positive initial biomasses in {1,2}; alpha>1 only; no extension to arbitrary graphs, heterogeneous coefficients or stochastic updates. Historical priority among equivalent cellular-automaton formulations is not completely settled.
title: Two sharp competition thresholds and exact surviving populations on ecological cycles
